title: The Open Kitchen Window
story: Sara came home and found the kitchen window open. A chair was pulled out, and a cup lay on its side. She felt afraid and called her brother, Idris. Together they checked the rooms, and nothing valuable was missing. Then they heard a soft sound from the bedroom. Their cat, Pip, walked out with a leaf caught on his tail. The window had a wide sill, and the tree outside stood close to it. Pip must have climbed in and knocked the cup over. Sara laughed with relief and closed the window. Idris wiped the table and set the chair back. They looked at the latch and saw that it was loose. Sara wrote a note asking everyone to test the latch before leaving. She fixed it that evening with a small screwdriver. The next morning the window stayed shut, and Pip waited by the door.
